_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Is tu Player {player_id}, a' cluich {num_rounds} cuairtean de Geama Ultimatum Ath-riochdaichte.
Tha ${pool} agad airson a roinn eadar thu fhèin is Player {other_id} anns an cuairt seo.

Tairgse:
  - Dèan tairgse: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ma ghabh thu ri → Gheibh thu $(pool - X), gheibh an tèilean eile $X
  - Ma dhiùlt thu → Gheibh an dithis $0
  - Eisimpleir: [Offer: $3]  no  'Saoilidh mi gu bheil seo cothromach. [Offer: $5]'

Freagairt:
  - Ro-inn an tairgse le [Accept] no [Reject]
  - Eisimpleir: 'Tha sin a' coimhead reusanta. [Accept]'
            'Rò mhòr an t-ainneart. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Tha Cuairt {round_number} a' tòiseachadh! ---
Tha Cluicheadair {proposer_id} na thagraiche, tha Cluicheadair {responder_id} na freagairtiche.
round.offer: Cuairt {round_number}: Tha Cluicheadair {proposer_id} a' tabhann ${offer} do Chluicheadair {responder_id} (a' giùlan ${keep}).
round.accepted: Chaidh Cluicheadair {responder_id} a ghabhail! Cuairt {round_number}: Cluicheadair {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Cluicheadair {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Iomraidhean ùra: Cluicheadair 0: ${total_0}, Cluicheadair 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Dhiùlt Player {responder_id} an tairgse! Cuairt {round_number} duaisean: An dithis +$0. Tha na h-uimhirean a' fuireach mar a tha iad: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Feumaidh an t-solaraiche tairgse a dhèanamh le bhith a' cleachdadh cruth [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Feumaidh suim an tairgse a bhith na fhìor àireamh iomlan.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Feumaidh an tairgse a bhith eadar $0 agus ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Chan eil tairgse gnàthach ri freagairt.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Feumaidh an Freagairtiche [Accept] no [Reject] a' chuideachaidh a ghabhail.

outcome.win: Bhuannaich Cluicheadair {winner} le ${winner_total} iomlan an aghaidh ${loser_total} aig Cluicheadair {loser}.
outcome.draw: Dealbhaich! Chrìochnaich an dà chluicheadair le ${total} gu h-iomlan.
